info.name: List uploaded images for a project

params.name: account_id
params.description: ID of the account that owns the retrieved/saved data

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project to be retrieved

items.docs:
Retrieves a list of images that have been uploaded to the Convert CDN for a specific project.
These images can be used in experience variations. Supports pagination.
The Knowledge Base article "Image Upload Guidelines for Convert Visual Editor" mentions image upload limits.
